name: A Gift in Celebration
description: A large-scale Prime Ice sculpture found within Snezhnograd. Its striking symmetry makes it an important local landmark.\nIt is said that, to celebrate Anastasya Feodorovna's coronation as the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya, the Snegurochka Princess of the mountain manor personally crafted this magnificent and exquisite Prime Ice sculpture.\n"Even the ice that never melts is but a creation of magic, and thus it cannot truly endure. But so long as someone tends to it with care, then perhaps this nation, too, may endure as ever-new, just like the many Prime Ice constructs left behind from ages past."
